headline: True
claim_text: Cross-channel alignment and low-frequency spatial structure matter to the canonical members, but parallel order cannot yet be separated from the low-frequency envelope.
scope: invariant_tilde_f members on the varied-gradient panel
limitations: Every input edit is a deliberately off-manifold network diagnostic.

headline: True
claim_text: Members share a coarse channel and representation-level story, not one common signed position-by-position mechanism.
scope: original f and invariant_tilde_f kept separate; top-10 attribution and all-100 representation evidence
limitations: CKA does not establish identical computation and the low-pass path is baseline-dependent.

headline: True
claim_text: A 17-feature invariant vocabulary with registered drive interactions reproduces about 86% of held-out member-output variance, but it is not an exact formula for the networks or their units.
scope: three invariant_tilde_f members and member mean; physical GX target separate
limitations: The 0.91 completeness decoder includes GX diagnostics; only 13/64 bottleneck units reach R2 >= 0.8; PySR is deferred.

headline: True
claim_text: All four physical candidates are observationally associated with GX output, but none is intervention-ready and no physical causal effect has been measured.
scope: observed GX fixed-gradient panel; no network inference in S13
limitations: Post-match imbalance is 1.068-4.151 against 0.5 and overlap is 0.232-0.478 against 0.8.

headline: True
claim_text: Geodesic-curvature/compression is the highest-value next physical target because its independent GX gain is fold-robust even though its learned recurrence is weaker than f_stab and the localized peak.
scope: three invariant_tilde_f members plus observed fixed-drive GX outcomes
limitations: This is a prioritization under failed balance/overlap, not a causal ranking.

headline: True
claim_text: The tested evidence contradicts a claim that the networks encode and use GX zonal-flow magnitude as a specific hidden mechanism.
scope: top-three invariant_tilde_f hidden representations and observed GX zonal diagnostic
limitations: Observed zonal association is not the same as direct network access to zonal flow.

headline: True
claim_text: Ensemble spread is a useful error-ranking diagnostic but not a calibrated confidence interval or guaranteed error bound.
scope: all-100 invariant_tilde_f ensemble on the varied-gradient panel
limitations: Members share data and architecture; threshold counts are sensitivity-dependent.
